title: Nearest point of spt V to a nearby point, and the empty ball around it
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l), V a RectifiableVarifold n l U with weight mu = V.weight (so V.support = U ∩ spt mu, spt mu = Measure.support mu), rho real and zeta in R^(n+l); put d := infDist(zeta, V.support). If 0 ∈ V.support, the closed ball B_rho(0) ⊆ U, and |zeta| + d <= rho, then there is y in V.support with dist(y, zeta) = d, and the open ball of radius d about zeta has mu-measure 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ρ : ℝ) (ζ : Amb n ℓ), (0 : Amb n ℓ) ∈ V.support → closedBall (0 : Amb n ℓ) ρ ⊆ U → ‖ζ‖ + infDist ζ V.support ≤ ρ → ∃ y ∈ V.support, dist y ζ = infDist ζ V.support ∧ V.weight (ball ζ (infDist ζ V.support)) = 0
